remediated_findings.evidence: The strict evaluation request accepts only immutable record IDs. The server reloads the intake, job tree, fact versions, current reviews, and source authorization before deriving gates, salary, fit, confidence, preferences, readiness, and risk.

listing-requirements-v3 preserves supported ANY_OF alternatives, incomplete material hard parsing blocks evaluation, and the active route evaluates the reconstructed persisted tree with evaluateRequirementTree.

Immutable idempotent selection runs and members persist base rank, selected rank, rank explanation, selector explanation, and each diversity displacement. Active search, release, and replacement paths require the run identity.

Five explanation sections bind exact evidence nodes and candidate fact versions. Matching-experience output is rendered from current confirmed or independently verified candidate facts; typed criteria checks and employer sections use their persisted evidence.

The fit calculator returns null with NO_APPLICABLE_COMPONENTS for a zero applicable denominator and rejects non-finite results. The product path still enforces the contract's always-applicable core-responsibility component.
Persisted evaluation loading fetches the latest authorization per source; selection, deliverability, and release verification reject a superseded or revoked linked authorization.

The evaluation route loads every persisted intake criterion and deriveCustomerHardGates creates independent gates for work mode, geography/state and conditional commute, employment type, hard title restriction, blocked industries, schedules, must-have benefits, dealbreakers including custom text, and hard work conditions. Missing employer evidence remains blocking unless the exact immutable criterion policy allows it.

listing-requirements-v4 preserves three-letter currency, RANGE/STARTING_AT/UP_TO/FIXED endpoint meaning, and location applicability. Production salary comparison requires the current exact-subject compensation review and exact cited listing node; unsupported currency and ambiguous location ranges fail closed.

Migration 028 backfills stable review subject keys, permits one current review per exact subject, atomically invalidates the prior current review on insert, and uses per-job/per-subject advisory locks. The evaluation route rejects any caller-supplied review ID that is no longer current.

A parser correction reparses corrected listing text and atomically persists a new immutable job snapshot, requirement tree with correction history, inventory version/member, and cloned coverage lineage. The old job is superseded, its evaluations are invalidated, and both route and database guards reject further evaluation against it.

Equal-weight preference derivation covers desired responsibility, exact title, optional industry, preferred work mode, preferred employment type, would-prefer benefit, schedule, soft avoidance, and target pay. Accepted hard choices are not double counted.

Ingestion persists 1.00 only when an active source-registry record verifies employer-hosted application provenance. Manual or third-party discovery remains 0.80, caller labels and same-host coincidence cannot inflate it, and confidence uses the minimum persisted material-source quality.

Hard-requirement outcomes are derived from exact current persisted candidate facts, semantic relevance, capability status, independently substantiating authorization, overlap-safe calendar duration, and FTE intensity. Reviewer dispositions classify evidence but cannot manufacture a passing outcome; contradictions fail closed.
The review route and migration 029 require typed customer-criterion evidence for the exact criterion and reject wrong-node, stale-fact, or absent-node assertions.
Commute is evaluated only for the actual HYBRID or ONSITE job mode. Schedule answers are retained as soft preferences and are not duplicated as hard gates.

listing-requirements-v5 preserves Boolean alternatives, handles not-remote and weekday/weekend negation, promotes required physical and travel thresholds into the hard tree, and marks material unsupported hard language incomplete so evaluation cannot bypass it.
Application provenance is selected server-side from the source registry. Raw URLs, caller labels, and same-host coincidence cannot claim EMPLOYER_HOSTED; manual discovery remains quality 0.80.
Fit uses candidate facts semantically relevant to the exact criterion, and requirement-tree unknowns are reported only when counterfactual evaluation proves they can change the root outcome.
